abort.already_configured: This bwa Wi-Fi Module is already configured

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to this bwa Wi-Fi Module, please try again

error.invalid_rgb: Invalid RGB value. Use the format R,G,B with each value between 0 and 255 (e.g. 255,0,0)

data.sync_time: Keep your Balboa BP controller's time synchronized with Home Assistant
data.sync_time_interval_note: How often to sync the spa's clock with Home Assistant, in hours (1-24)
data.keepalive_enabled: Enable periodic keep-alive (usually not needed, the spa already pushes status updates on its own)
data.keepalive_frame_type: Keep-alive frame type: "existing_client_request" (default, gets a real reply from the WiFi module) or "minimal" (silent frame, no reply)
data.keepalive_missed_updates_enabled: Also send a keep-alive if the spa's spontaneous updates (usually every ~300ms) stop arriving
data.keepalive_missed_updates_threshold_note: Number of missed spontaneous spa updates (~300ms each, 1-200) before sending a keep-alive - 200 is about 1 minute of silence
data.fault_log_refresh_interval_note: How often to re-request the fault log while the connection stays up, in hours (1-24)

data.led_delay_on_note: How long the light stays on during a color cycle pulse
data.led_delay_off_note: How long the light stays off during a color cycle pulse
data.led_delay_reset_note: How long to wait before the color cycle resets back to the first color

data.name: Color name
data.cycles: Number of on/off cycles to reach this color
data.rgb: RGB value (for display only, format: R,G,B)
